### **Start the server**

```bash
llama-server -m ~/models/Qwen3.5-9B-Q4_K_M.gguf \
  -ngl 99 \
  -c 65536 \
  -np 1 \
  -fa on \
  --cache-type-k q4_0 \
  --cache-type-v q4_0 \
  --host 127.0.0.1
```

### **Useful commands**

Check status:

```bash
curl http://127.0.0.1:8080/status
```

Stop the server:

```bash
pkill llama-server
```

Restart the server:

```bash
llama-server -m ~/models/Qwen3.5-9B-Q4_K_M.gguf \
  -ngl 99 \
  -c 65536 \
  -np 1 \
  -fa on \
  --cache-type-k q4_0 \
  --cache-type-v q4_0 \
  --host 127.0.0.1
```

Open API docs:

```bash
openclaw gateway status
```

Local API URL:

```bash
http://127.0.0.1:8080/
```
